text:
ash: Fwding notes from the sync with Sales about per-route quotas + bursting credits. Need a quick product decision: credits-based burst model vs strict per-second caps?
maria: TL;DR from eng: credits gives flexibility, easier for bursty apps, but more complexity in billing + meter.
sam: customers asking for per-route isolation (chat vs embeddings vs function-calls) so they can cap costs on auto-generating embeddings.
jordan: +1 for route isolation. Also function/tool calls are higher backend cost; we should weight them heavier than plain tokens.
chris: Proposal: per-tenant monthly quota in "billing units", with product-defined weights per route. Burst credits pool that can be consumed for short spikes, refilled at steady rate. Enforcement via leaky-bucket.
elaine: That maps to what enterprise asked: ability to set a strict per-route hard cap AND a shared soft pool for all routes. UI needs to show both.
nash: @maria can we estimate telemetry delta for implementing weights (function calls x2, tool calls x3, embeddings per-vector)?
maria: rough ballpark: server-side metering + tagging adds ~1-2% ingestion cost. Weight multipliers are easy; main effort is backfilling historical usage for billing reports.
sam: Also need to define units: tokens vs embeddings vectors. Billing can't mix them raw. Suggest canonicalize to "billing unit" where 1 embedding vector = N billing units, 1 token = 0.01 unit (example).
jordan: Example mapping we discussed: chat token = 0.01 unit, function call overhead = +0.5 unit per call, embedding vector = 2 units. We can tune numbers.
chris: Important: rounding rules and minimums. Customers will game tiny requests. Set per-request floor (e.g., min 0.1 unit).
nash: UX/Console fields we need: route_key, per_route_monthly_cap (billing units), soft_pool_allocation, burst_window_seconds, refill_rate_per_sec, weight_map.
elaine: And rollout: 1) internal flagged customers, 2) opt-in beta, 3) default opt-out until billing + reports ready. Launch criteria: billing reconciliation tested, UI controls in console, 2 weeks of staging telemetry showing no false positives.
ops-bot: Deploy started: feature/credits-bursting -> staging at 1769504400.
maria: Notes on enforcement: we should prefer 429 with clear error body listing remaining credits + reset ETA; fallback to cheaper model variant when soft pool exhausted (if configured).
sam: Example error payload we can return:
```json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "route": "chat.v1",
  "remaining_credits": 0,
  "retry_after_seconds": 120
}
```
jordan: Also expose per-route metrics: consumed_units_total, consumed_units_window, burst_events, throttled_requests. Needed for SLOs.
chris: Billing integration: ledger events must include original token counts, billing_units_consumed, weight_applied, and route_key. That way finance can audit.
nash: On scope: MVP should include chat/completions, embeddings, and function-call weighting. Rerank and structured-output can be treated as chat for now.
elaine: Customers asked for per-route quota APIs (set via API + console). Add endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/:id/quotas and GET to list.
maria: Implementation notes: state stored in redis (fast counters) + durable write to billing DB asynchronously. Need to handle clock skew for refill windows.
sam: Risk: complexity of backfills for existing billing. Mitigate: start with reporting-only mode where quotas are not enforced but alerts fire.
chris: Rollout timeline proposal: design docs + API spec by EOD Friday, eng spike next week, staging beta in 3 weeks, public beta in 8 weeks.
jordan: Can we get 2 customers for beta? I have a lead willing to try per-route caps.
nash: Launch checklist (brief): API + schema, console controls, billing ledger entries, E2E tests, telemetry dashboards + alerts, docs + changelog.
elaine: One more ask from Sales: admin override API so partner support can temporarily grant emergency credits. Add admin endpoint and audit logs.
maria: ok, will add admin override with TTL and audit event.
nash: Great. For the design doc, I'll outline the "billing unit" conversion table + enforcement pseudocode. Who wants to be co-author?
jordan: I can take the customer examples and error UX.
sam: I'll write the API spec and sample responses.
chris: I'll own rollout plan + SLO impact analysis.
nash: Thanks team. I'll open a GH PR with the spec and link here.
ops-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/421 at 1769504500
